```{=html}
<div class="sm-layout sm-mass-layout">
  <div class="sm-particle-map sm-mass-particle-map" aria-label="Standard Model with massive neutrinos">
    <div class="sm-sector sm-quark-sector">
      <h3>Quarks</h3>
      <div class="sm-doublet-row">
        <div class="sm-doublet-stack" aria-label="Doublet of u and d quarks"><div class="sm-doublet quark-doublet">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}u\\d\end{pmatrix}\)</div></div>
        <div class="sm-doublet-stack" aria-label="Doublet of c and s quarks"><div class="sm-doublet quark-doublet">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}c\\s\end{pmatrix}\)</div></div>
        <div class="sm-doublet-stack" aria-label="Doublet of t and b quarks"><div class="sm-doublet quark-doublet">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}t\\b\end{pmatrix}\)</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sm-multiplicity">\(\times 3\) colors</div>
    </div>

    <div class="sm-sector sm-lepton-sector">
      <h3>Leptons</h3>
      <div class="sm-doublet-row">
        <div class="sm-doublet lepton-doublet" aria-label="Neutrino nu 1 and electron">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}\nu_1\\e\end{pmatrix}\)</div>
        <div class="sm-doublet lepton-doublet" aria-label="Neutrino nu 2 and muon">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}\nu_2\\\mu\end{pmatrix}\)</div>
        <div class="sm-doublet lepton-doublet" aria-label="Neutrino nu 3 and tau lepton">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}\nu_3\\\tau\end{pmatrix}\)</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="sm-sector sm-boson-sector">
      <h3>Bosons</h3>
      <div class="sm-boson-row">
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge">\(\gamma\)</div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge">\(W^\pm\)</div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge">\(Z\)</div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge sm-gluon-cell"><span>\(g\)</span><span class="sm-boson-multiplicity">\(\times 8\)</span></div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell higgs">\(H\)</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="sm-pillars sm-mass-note">
    <p><strong>In free propagation:</strong></p>
    <p>neutrinos have definite masses \(m_1,m_2,m_3\).</p>
    <p><strong>In the weak interaction:</strong></p>
    <p>the states \(\nu_e,\nu_\mu,\nu_\tau\) are produced and detected.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
